name: Moringa Seeds - 100gms. Drumstick Seeds reduce cholesterol level, support healthy function of the liver and improve digestion
original_description:
Aayurvedaa Moringa Seeds contains the natural herb Moringa. It provides protein, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and other components that your diet may be lacking. It not only defends against free radicals, but it also boosts immunity. It promotes liver health and lowers the risk of diabetes.

It is an effective treatment for illnesses such as hypertension and diabetes. Moringa Seeds extracts might help treat some stomach disorders, such as constipation, gastritis, and ulcerative colitis. The antibiotic and antibacterial properties of moringa may help inhibit the growth of various pathogens, and its high vitamin B content helps with digestion.

Benefits of Moringa Seeds

  • It may help to reduce cholesterol level
  • It may help to support the healthy function of the liver
  • It has antioxidants which protect from damage by harmful free radicals
  • It has anti-inflammatory properties and also relieves joint pain
  • It may improve digestion and boost metabolism
